{{URL|inoxmovies.com}} }} '''PVR INOX Limited''' is an Indian [[Multiplex (movie theater)|multiplex]] chain. It was formed in 2023 as a result of the merger between [[PVR Cinemas]] and [[INOX Leisure]].{{Cite web |title=PVR Company History – Business Standard News |url=https://www.business-standard.com/company/pvr-14622/information/company-history |access-date=1 September 2021 |work=[[Business Standard]] |df=dmy-all |archive-date=1 September 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210901140735/https://www.business-standard.com/company/pvr-14622/information/company-history |url-status=live }}{{Cite web |last=Sen |first=Meghna |date=2023-01-12 |title=PVR-Inox merger approved by Mumbai NCLT |url=https://www.livemint.com/companies/news/pvrinox-merger-approved-by-mumbai-nclt-11673519127223.html |access-date=2023-08-07 |website=mint |language=en |archive-date=9 May 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230509125322/https://www.livemint.com/companies/news/pvrinox-merger-approved-by-mumbai-nclt-11673519127223.html |url-status=live }} PVR pioneered the multiplex revolution in India by establishing the first modern [[Multiplex (movie theater)|multiplex cinema]] in 1997 at [[Saket]], [[New Delhi]].{{Cite web |date=10 August 2022 |title=PVR Cinemas celebrates 25 years in cinematic entertainment |url=https://www.eventfaqs.com/news/ef-18329/pvr-cinemas-celebrates-25-years-in-cinematic-entertainment |access-date=4 September 2023 |website=Eventsfaqs.com |archive-date=4 September 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230904184314/https://www.eventfaqs.com/news/ef-18329/pvr-cinemas-celebrates-25-years-in-cinematic-entertainment |url-status=live }} As of May 2025, PVR INOX operates 1,743 screens across 352 properties in 111 cities of India and Sri Lanka.{{Cite web | title=PVR INOX Posts Q4 Loss at Rs 125.3 Crore; FY25 Revenue Dips 5 % to Rs 5,953.6 Crore – Outlook Business | url=https://www.outlookbusiness.com/corporate/pvr-inox-posts-q4-loss-at-rs-1253-crore-fy25-revenue-dips-5-to-rs-59536-crore | access-date=2026-07-17 | website=www.outlookbusiness.com}} == History == ===PVR Cinemas=== [[File:Pvrcinemas logo.jpg|thumb|200px|Logo used from 2001 until 2019|right]] PVR Cinemas has its origin as Priya Cinema in [[Vasant Vihar]], [[Delhi]]; the cinema hall was named after Priya Jaisinghani and was bought by [[Ajay Bijli]]'s father in 1978, who also owned a trucking business, Amritsar Transport Co. In 1988, Bijli took over the cinema hall, which was revamped in 1990.{{cite web | title = Questions & Answers: Ajay Bijli|work=[[The Wall Street Journal]]| url = https://online.wsj.com/news/articles/SB125904151522361983 |date=24 November 2009| access-date = 2014-09-24 }}{{cite web | title = How Ajay Bijli, the man behind PVR, managed to crack the movie theatre business in India | work = [[The Economic Times]] | url = http://articles.economictimes.indiatimes.com/2012-08-24/news/33366602_1_ajay-bijli-pvr-cinema | first = Peerzada | last = Abrar | date = 24 August 2012 | access-date = 2014-09-24 | archive-url = https://web.archive.org/web/20150614022407/http://articles.economictimes.indiatimes.com/2012-08-24/news/33366602_1_ajay-bijli-pvr-cinema | archive-date = 14 June 2015 | url-status = dead| df = dmy-all }} In 1995, the company was established as a 60:40 joint venture between Priya Exhibitors Private Limited and [[Village Roadshow]] of Australia, with commercial operations starting in June 1997 as Priya Village Roadshow (PVR). In 2003, ICICI Ventures invested {{INR}}40 crore in PVR when Village Roadshow decided to pull out of the partnership.{{Cite web |first=Suveen K. |last=Sinha Standard]] |df=dmy-all }} In 2006, the company's shares were listed on the National Stock Exchange (NSE) and the Bombay Stock Exchange (BSE).{{Cite web| title=Annual Report 2005-06 | extract: PVR INOX Limited is an Indian multiplex chain. It was formed in 2023 as a result of the merger between PVR Cinemas and INOX Leisure. PVR pioneered the multiplex revolution in India by establishing the first modern multiplex cinema in 1997 at Saket, New Delhi. As of May 2025, PVR INOX operates 1,743 screens across 352 properties in 111 cities of India and Sri Lanka.
